description: This file defines an interface named RouteCollectorProxyInterface within the Slim Framework, specifying methods for managing HTTP routes and route groups, including route addition for various HTTP methods, base path configuration, and redirection.

classes.name: RouteCollectorProxyInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for route collection and management within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Returns the response factory instance used to generate HTTP responses.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the resolver used to obtain callables for route callbacks.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the container associated with the route collector proxy, which may be null.

methods.name: getRouteCollector
methods.description: Returns the underlying route collector instance.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Retrieves the base path for the route collector proxy.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for all routes within this proxy.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Adds a GET route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Adds a POST route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a PUT route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Adds a PATCH route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds a DELETE route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Adds an OPTIONS route with a specified pattern and callback.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Adds a route applicable to any HTTP method.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a route that responds to multiple specified HTTP methods.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Defines a group of routes sharing a common pattern or middleware.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a route that sends an HTTP redirect to a specified location.
